text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Say, Trainer. I've actually got somewhere
I'd like
to go today as well. Is that all
right?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
The shop we were looking for the other
day. You
know, with the cherry pie?
choice_data_list: Of course. Where are you heading?
Of course. Where are you heading?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to Jordan's help, I was able to
narrow the location down quite a bit. I
think it's in the
shopping center in the
next town over.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
We're looking for a red roof. Reeed
roof...
Hmmm...
choice_data_list: Understood. Shall we head over, then?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Aha!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It sounds like Wonder Acute found
something. I
follow her gaze to a shop
with a red roof.

text_block_list.name: Bakery Owner
text_block_list.text: Good afternoon! What can I get for you?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: I've got a question for you, actually.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She explains how she thinks she may
have come
here a long time ago and
asks if they're still
selling cherry pie.

text_block_list.name: Bakery Owner
text_block_list.text:
Cherry pie, huh? It sounds like
something that might've been on the
menu back when my grandmother ran
the place. She actually passed the shop
down to me.

text_block_list.name: Bakery Owner
text_block_list.text:
She left a few of her recipes, but I'm
afraid we're
not currently selling cherry
pie.

text_block_list.name: Bakery Owner
text_block_list.text:
We don't even have the ingredients, I'm
afraid.
I'm sorry you came all this way...

text_block_list.name: Bakery Owner
text_block_list.text:
Oh! But I do have the recipe. I could
share it with
you if you'd like it.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh my! I would love that! But are you
sure you
don't mind?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I can't believe I get to have that
pie again.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute must have really liked the
pie,
seeing as she's grinning from ear to
ear.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We purchase a few pastries as a token of
thanks for the recipe, then stop by a
grocery store on
our way back to buy
the ingredients for the pie.
choice_data_list: (At least we managed to find the r...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She makes the pie within the day and
invites
Copano Rickey and Hokko
Tarumae to join us.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for waiting! One cherry pie
featuring
the heavenly smell of nutmeg
coming up. Eat up,
everyone.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! It's such a bright and vivid pink!
It's
adorable!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Mmm-mmm-mmm! Deee-licious!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
This pie is amazing, Acute! I can
practically feel
the happiness calling!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
It really does remind me of old times! My
chest feels nice and warm—the flavor is
so different
from haskap, but still
nice. ♪

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Really? I'm so glad you like it.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Seeing the smiles on your faces makes
all the
searching worth it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I notice some tension leave Wonder
Acute's
shoulders, and something occurs
to me.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Totally! It sounds like the kind of pie
that would
brighten your life! I wanna try
it too! I bet you do
too, huh, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Was that whole search just because of
what we all
said back then?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Good food tastes even better when you
eat with
friends.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, there's no need to thank me for

something like this. I'm happy to do it
anytime.
choice_data_list: Thank you for doing this for us.
Thank you for doing this for us.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, there's no need to thank me for

something like this. I'm happy to do it
anytime.
choice_data_list: You really care about your friends...
You really care about your friends...
You're really great at making sweets.
You're really great at making swee...
I'll make you something in return ...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Oho, you're going to make me blush.
choice_data_list: You really care about your friends...
You really care about your friends...
You're really great at making sweets.
You're really great at making swee...
I'll make you something in return ...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I just wanted to do something to thank
everyone
for being so kind and
welcoming.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I enjoy baking and seeing
people eat my
cooking. It's a win-win for
everybody.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I tell her that her cherry pie, as well as
everything
else she makes, is absolutely
delicious.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear. Hearing that makes me want to
put the
apron back on and cook some
more.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I don't want to toot my own horn, but
there are a
lot more things I can make.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I think I'll make something more
traditional next
time, like dango or
warabi mochi. Oh, or maybe
ohagi.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'd feel bad if she was always the one
cooking, so
I tell her that I'd like to try
cooking sometime, even if I'm not sure
how well it'll go.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Well, aren't you sweet. That sounds fun.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Why don't we make something
together? I'm sure
it'll come out
splendid that way.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That kind of defeats the purpose of a
thank-you
gift, but if Wonder Acute is
all right with it, then
so am I.
